language.tooltip: Language of the indicator and its tooltip. This settings window is always English. Error messages are always English too.

display-mode.description: What to show in the panel

show-pace-mark.description: Pace mark on the session bar
show-pace-mark.tooltip: A thin mark showing how much of the five-hour window has already passed. Fill above the mark means spending is outrunning the window's recovery.

threshold-warn.tooltip: Below this value the indicator is green.

threshold-crit.tooltip: Raised to the amber threshold automatically if set below it.

polling-enabled.tooltip: Stops all requests to api.anthropic.com. The applet stays in the panel showing the last known values, dimmed; a click still fetches fresh data. To remove the applet entirely use the Applets manager — then it will not come back at the next login either.

update-interval.tooltip: How often to ask api.anthropic.com for the usage. At least 30 seconds always passes between any two requests.

click-to-refresh.tooltip: A left click on the indicator fetches fresh data, at most once every 30 seconds.

skip-when-idle.description: Skip polling while Claude Code is idle
skip-when-idle.tooltip: If ~/.claude/history.jsonl has not changed for half an hour there is nothing to spend, and the poll is skipped: needless requests only bring a 429 closer. The indicator is dimmed meanwhile, and a click still refreshes.

credentials-path.tooltip: Leave empty for ~/.claude/.credentials.json. The file is only ever read.
